messages:
Acme CI: our CI started failing right after we bumped to github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk v1.5.0. error from `go get`/build:
```
go: github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk@v1.5.0: reading github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/go.mod at revision v1.5.0: module declares its path as: github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/v2
	but was required as: github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk
```
Logs attached (CI job 482). Can you advise?

Ella (support): thanks for the report — escalating to eng. @kevin any idea what might cause this?

Kevin (engineer): that error is the classic module-path/major-version mismatch. If the module was bumped to v2 the module path must include `/v2` and consumers must import `.../v2`. Two likely causes: the tag points at code whose go.mod expects `/v2` but the tag name used was `v1.*`, or the published tag's go.mod wasn't updated. Can you paste the release tag commit sha?

Acme CI: tag is `v1.5.0` -> commit `a1b2c3d4`. We ran `go get github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk@v1.5.0` in CI (no vendoring).

Tom (release): looking now. Confirmed: `v1.5.0` was created off the branch that had the new v2 module path change in go.mod — looks like a tagging mistake. We inadvertently tagged a v2-ready commit as v1.5.0. Oops.

Caroline (support): temporary workarounds for the customer until we republish: either 1) pin to the prior release commit (before the go.mod v2 change) via `go get github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk@<old-commit>` or 2) update imports to include `/v2` and `go get github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/v2@v2.0.0` once we publish. Avoid `replace` hacks unless you vendor or use a local path; that gets messy for CI.

Kevin (engineer): agreed. We'll cut a corrected tag. Plan: (A) create v1.5.1 that matches the expected module path for users who want v1 line, and (B) publish a proper v2.0.0 tag with `module github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/v2` in go.mod for users moving to v2. Also adding a CI check to validate go.mod module path matches tag major.

release-bot: created draft releases: v1.5.1 (hotfix) and v2.0.0 (proper v2 tag). Artifacts uploaded to release drafts.

Kevin (engineer): pushed and published v1.5.1 and v2.0.0; both pushed to proxy. Customers on v1, please `go get github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk@v1.5.1`. Customers moving to v2, update imports to `github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/v2` and `go get github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/v2@v2.0.0`. Added release checklist item: "verify go.mod module path vs tag major".

Acme CI: switching to `/v2` import and `go get github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/v2@v2.0.0` fixed our build. CI job 483 passed. Thanks! :thumbsup:

Ella (support): marking thread resolved. Action items: Tom/kev — please add the checklist entry to the release runbook and notify the release on-call. Filing follow-up ticket: REL-1482.

Tom (release): will do, adding note and pinging on-call.

Kevin (engineer): closing loop, thanks everyone.
